address: Das Ameas 2, Santiago de Compostela, 15704, Spain
bio: Chef Lucía Freitas' more informal style! It is located next to the bustling Mercado de Abastos and offers a contemporary menu where grilled meats are the main attraction, with various starters, some seafood, grilled Iberian pork... and, always, a set dish with fish of the day in caldeirada and two gourmet hamburgers. Also, if you prefer to go all out, they offer the option of a tasting menu....
